controlAgent: This agent should be responsible for handling tasks related to system control and automation, such as applying throttle resolution. It should have the capability to interact with system components, adjust settings, and monitor performance. The controlAgent should be designed to work seamlessly with other agents, receiving and executing commands to maintain optimal system operation. It should also be able to handle tasks related to resource allocation, prioritization, and optimization, ensuring that system resources are utilized efficiently.
